## Developer Checklist

- [ ] I tested install from the generated driver ZIP in Haptique OS.
- [ ] I tested uninstall or rollback behavior.
- [ ] I confirmed no secrets, tokens, passwords, private IPs, or customer data are committed.
- [ ] I explained every requested permission in the package manifest.
- [ ] I confirmed the driver uses the OS-owned Logical Device UI contract and only provides UI hints or optional widgets.
- [ ] I disclosed any required cloud service, account, subscription, or external dependency.
- [ ] I published the release ZIP from the source repository.
- [ ] I added the release ZIP SHA256 as `artifact.sha256`.

## Maintainer Review

- [ ] Schema validation passes.
- [ ] Package id and source repository match the submitter's intent.
- [ ] Artifact URL points to a release asset, not an unreviewed branch archive.
- [ ] SHA256 matches the release artifact.
- [ ] Permissions are proportionate to behavior.
- [ ] Logical Device UI fields are present and OS-renderable.
- [ ] Trust level is appropriate for this submission.
